_comment: Reviewed verdicts for every distinct EXTERNAL_COPYRIGHT_NOTICE carried by a LOINC term in this repository slice.

Section 10(b) of the LOINC license gives two options for third-party content inside LOINC: comply with that third party terms, or delete the content. This file records which option each notice gets, and why.

THE RULE: a notice is `restricted` ONLY when its text explicitly disallows the use, whether by requiring a licence, by requiring written permission, or by limiting the purpose of use. Everything else is `permissive` and ships with its notice attached. A bare reservation of rights ("All rights reserved") with no stated condition is NOT an explicit prohibition and is therefore permissive; so is a condition that shipping the notice verbatim already satisfies (keep the attribution, do not alter the instrument), because this repository never edits LOINC values.
Only data that is explicitly disallowed is withheld. Ambiguity is not a reason to withhold, and it is not a reason to ship either: a notice with no verdict here stops the build.
`permissive` rows are emitted with the notice attached. `restricted` rows are withheld entirely.

THIS FILE IS FAIL-CLOSED. The builder and the licence validator both refuse any notice text that is not listed here verbatim, naming the notice and the codes carrying it. A new or reworded notice in the next LOINC release stops the build and gets a human verdict; it never defaults into either bucket. Matching is on the exact notice string, not a pattern, because a pattern can only recognise the restrictions somebody already thought of.
Sorted by holder. `notice` is byte-identical to the release EXTERNAL_COPYRIGHT_NOTICE field.

_rule.restricted: explicitly disallows the use, whether by requiring a licence, requiring written permission, or limiting the purpose of use
_rule.permissive: everything else, including a notice that reserves rights without stating any condition on use
